_comment: Template for the real licensed artifact. Copy to config.json, download the
source, fill in sourceSha256 from the release checksum, then run
The artifact is not vendored: it is large, licensed, and must stay out of git.
The sha256 is a PIN, not a formality — the build refuses to run on a mismatch.
